content: .{@-कच्छपः@} , म(मा)ण्डूकः, -की (<ab>lit.</ab>) a tortoise or frog in a well; (<ab>fig.</ab>) an inexperienced person, one who has had no experience of the world at large, a man of limited ideas who knows only his own neighbourhood; <ab>oft.</ab> used as a term of reproach; यद्यसौ कूपमाण्डूकि तवैतावति कः स्मयः <ls>Bk. 5. 85</ls>.
